note: Real pages of the survey: URLs only (no page content here). Snapshots for offline runs (snapshot.ts) are vendored in danbri/factoidal-builds third_party/realpages/<site>/, with the licence and attribution given here. lab: URLs are pages of this lab. viewport is WIDTHxHEIGHT in CSS px at scale 1; mobile rows give Chrome an iPhone user agent (Foafnaut sends its own). scripts:false runs with --no-scripts. budgets: the goal for each summary field; a page over a budget is listed, not failed. A page's own budgets override the defaults. snapshot: the id of another page whose snapshot this page uses (the same URL).
